tickets.text: My external monitor isn't detected when docked

steps: Check that the Thunderbolt cable connecting your laptop to the dock is fully seated and has clicked into place.
If the monitor still isn't detected, try plugging the monitor cable directly into the laptop to see if the issue persists without the dock.
Check that the monitor input is set to USB-C if applicable (e.g., model U2723QE).
Check for firmware updates for the WD22TB4 using the Dell Peripheral Manager on your laptop.
input.rationale: The most common cause for docking issues is the connection, and the troubleshooting steps for the WD22TB4 dock are well-documented for the user to perform.
